## Teaching points

1. Palpable pulses do not exclude compartment syndrome. Escalating pain and stretch pain after crush injury warrant urgent orthopedic assessment.
2. Normal foot pulses do not establish adequate muscle perfusion inside a tight compartment.
3. Escalation and surgical decompression are time-critical; pain relief must not substitute for serial examination.
4. Pressure measurement can help an uncertain or unreliable examination; an obvious clinical emergency must not wait for routine imaging.
